title: External architecture research integration: capability overlap and POC decision matrix
objective: Read the landed external research verification package, current project architecture, PR #15 acceptance evidence, and PR #16 governance files; then produce six integration-decision reports covering capability overlap, architecture decisions, POC decision matrix, existing-task impact, implementation sequence, and open questions. Do not implement any POC. Do not modify existing task specs or product source code.
